Shiv Sena (UBT) leader's murder: Police arrest four, form SIT

Police have arrested four individuals in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena (UBT) division chief Pradeep alias Balu Purnekar. Two accused were apprehended near Alibag while attempting to flee to Goa, bringing the total number of arrests to three. The arrests followed the earlier apprehension of the shooter and an accomplice. A 23-member Special Investigation Team (SIT) has been formed to probe the murder.
